gloss_en: "who are pleasant [to one another] in halakhic discussion" (she-man'imim ba-halakhah) — the Talmudic description (cf. Sanhedrin 24a) of Torah scholars of the Land of Israel who treat each other graciously in halakhic debate, linked here to no'am (Supernal Pleasantness) as the aspect of the rectified 'mentalities of the Land of Israel,' in contrast to the 'destroyers' (chovlim) of outside the Land
